shaSeparation.note: Per SKYLINE 2026-06-28 Continuous Delivery Master Directive, every checkpoint manifest preserves the three-way SHA separation. reviewedCandidateSha is the exact SHA Codex C7 review was issued against; manifestCommitSha is this manifest's own commit; integrationSha is the post-merge Train HEAD. Substituting one for another is a tier violation.
